validation.platform: Windows / native WPF Settings / Win32 global hotkeys
validation.source: Automated native Settings fixture with real SendInput and RegisterHotKey; screenshots are cropped composed desktop pixels.
checks: Left and right Windows + F13 both record through real native key input; right Windows replaces a distinct Ctrl+Shift+A value.
Windows with Control, Shift, Alt and all modifiers retains the full modifier mask; an existing Ctrl+Shift shortcut still records correctly.
Bare Control, Shift, Alt and both Windows keys leave the field unchanged while held; a key without modifiers is ignored.
Duplicate assignment remains rejected; Escape clears only the focused shortcut; a subsequent valid chord clears feedback.

Recorded settings JSON roundtrip preserves Windows modifiers. After Settings closes, production RegisterHotKey registration and native SendInput produce callbacks 1, 2, 3; removing Windows produces none.

native_shortcut_fixture.line_endings: Source artifact uses CRLF; durable JSON uses LF. Parsed validation values are identical.
